title: Himachal Alpine Bliss: Shimla & Manali with Rohtang Pass
overview: Experience the crown jewel of Himachal Pradesh. From the colonial heritage of Mall Road in Shimla to adrenaline-pumping snow adventures in Solang Valley and crossing the world-famous Atal Tunnel.
highlights: Walk the historic British Ridge and Christ Church in Shimla
Adrenaline adventure in Solang Valley: Zorbing, quad biking, and skiing
Epic excursion to Atal Tunnel (10,040 ft) and Sissu Glacier Waterfall
Evening bonfire, warm Himachali cuisine, and luxury mountain view resort

itinerary.title: Arrival in Shimla & Colonial Walk
itinerary.description: Arrive in Shimla, check into hotel. Afternoon stroll on Mall Road, visit Christ Church, Scandal Point, and Lakkar Bazaar for wooden handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Kufri Sightseeing & Himalayan Nature Park
itinerary.description: Excursion to Kufri (8,600 ft). Enjoy pony rides to Mahasu Peak, Himalayan Nature Park (snow leopards & musk deer), and panoramic snow views.

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Manali via Kullu Valley
itinerary.description: Picturesque road trip past Pandoh Dam, Sundernagar Lake, and Hanogi Mata Temple. Stop in Kullu for authentic shawl weaving factory visit.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel & Sissu Lahaul
itinerary.description: Traverse through the record-breaking Atal Tunnel to enter the snowy valleys of Lahaul. Thrilling snow sports in Solang Valley.

itinerary.title: Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs & Old Manali Cafes
itinerary.description: Visit 450-year-old Hadimba Devi Temple, dip in natural sulfur hot springs at Vashisht, explore Old Manali's bohemian cafes and German bakeries.

itinerary.title: Farewell Himachal & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning breakfast with pine valley panorama. Check out and head to airport/railway station with unforgettable memories.

inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in handpicked 3-Star / 4-Star resorts
Daily delicious buffet breakfast and dinner (MAP plan)
Private AC / Heating car for all transfers and sightseeing throughout the tour
Atal Tunnel and Solang Valley excursion permits
Driver allowances, toll taxes, parking fees, and fuel charges
24x7 local on-ground Go Orbit tour coordinator
exclusions: Personal adventure activity fees (paragliding, zorbing, snow scooter)
Entry tickets to monuments and museums
Room heater charges (if requested directly at reception)

title: Kashmir Dreamland: Srinagar, Gulmarg & Pahalgam Valley
overview: Immerse in timeless romance and untouched alpine grandeur in the Kashmir Valley. Stay in luxury carved cedar houseboats on Dal Lake, ride the world's 2nd highest cable car in Gulmarg, and walk through Lidder River valleys in Pahalgam.
highlights: Complimentary romantic sunset Shikara ride on Dal Lake
1 Night stay in heritage Super Deluxe Dal Lake Houseboat
Gulmarg Gondola Ride up to Apharwat Peak snowline
Pahalgam Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & saffron farm visits

itinerary.title: Welcome to Srinagar & Sunset Shikara Ride
itinerary.description: Meet our representative at Srinagar Airport. Transfer to luxury houseboat on Dal Lake. Enjoy a 1-hour sunset Shikara ride past floating lotus gardens.

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens & Srinagar Heritage
itinerary.description: Explore Shalimar Bagh, Nishat Bagh (Garden of Pleasure), and Chashme Shahi terraced gardens. Visit Shankaracharya Temple atop hill.

itinerary.title: Meadow of Flowers: Gulmarg Gondola Ride
itinerary.description: Drive through pine slopes to Gulmarg. Board the famous Gondola Cable Car to Phase 1 (Kongdoori) & Phase 2 (Apharwat Peak 13,780 ft) for snow skiing.

itinerary.title: Saffron Fields & Journey to Pahalgam (Valley of Shepherds)
itinerary.description: Pass through saffron fields of Pampore and Awantipora ruins. Arrive at Pahalgam on the banks of gushing Lidder river.

itinerary.title: Betaab Valley, Chandanwari & Aru Valley
itinerary.description: Explore scenic Betaab Valley, starting point of Amarnath Yatra at Chandanwari, and alpine village of Aru with horse trails.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast overlooking pine ridges. Check out and transfer to Srinagar Airport with sweet memories and authentic Kashmiri saffron.

inclusions: 1 Night stay in Deluxe Dal Lake Houseboat + 4 Nights in 4-Star resorts
Daily breakfast & Kashmiri Wazwan / multi-cuisine dinner
Complimentary 1-hour Shikara boat ride on Dal Lake
All transfers & sightseeing in private Innova/Crysta vehicle
Toll taxes, fuel, interstate permit and driver charges
exclusions: Gondola cable car ticket Phase 1 & 2 (can be pre-booked with us)
Pony / horse ride charges in Pahalgam & Gulmarg
Union taxi fees for Aru / Chandanwari valley local sightseeing

title: Enchanting Kerala: Munnar Hills, Thekkady & Alleppey Houseboat
overview: Unwind in the tropical tranquility of God's Own Country. Watch morning mist roll over Munnar tea hills, spot wild elephants on a boat safari in Periyar, and glide through emerald backwaters on your private air-conditioned houseboat.
highlights: Private AC traditional Kettuvallam Houseboat cruise with all meals
Munnar Eravikulam National Park and Mattupetty Dam
Spice plantation walk and authentic Kathakali cultural show in Thekkady
Sunset at Fort Kochi Chinese fishing nets

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar: Waterfalls & Tea Gardens
itinerary.description: Pick up from Cochin Airport / Ernakulam Railway Station. Drive through rubber estates and stop at Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Arrive in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Hills & Eravikulam National Park
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park (habitat of Nilgiri Tahr), Tea Museum with tea-tasting session, Mattupetty Dam, and Echo Point.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady: Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Scenic road trip to Thekkady. Visit aromatic cardamom and cinnamon plantations. Evening Periyar Lake wildlife boat cruise and Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey: Private Houseboat Cruise
itinerary.description: Board your private traditional Kettuvallam houseboat at noon. Cruise through palm-shaded canals, witnessing village duck farming and lush paddy fields.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Fort Kochi Heritage
itinerary.description: Disembark after morning breakfast. Drive to historic Fort Kochi. Tour St. Francis Church, Santa Cruz Basilica, Jew Town, and Chinese Cantilever Nets at sunset.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cochin
itinerary.description: Final Kerala breakfast with appam & stew. Transfer to Cochin International Airport for flight home.

inclusions: 1 Night on Private AC Houseboat with all 3 authentic Kerala meals
4 Nights in luxury 4-star boutique plantation hotels
Daily breakfast & dinner at hotels
All transfers in private chauffeur-driven AC sedan / SUV
Spice plantation guided tour pass
exclusions: Kathakali and Kalaripayattu evening show entry tickets
Periyar Lake boat safari tickets (direct booking at park counter)

title: Dubai Extravaganza: Burj Khalifa, Desert Safari & Atlantis
overview: Step into tomorrow's city today. Stand atop the Burj Khalifa on the 124th floor, conquer desert red dunes in a 4x4 Land Cruiser, cruise Dubai Marina aboard a luxury yacht, and marvel at the Museum of the Future.
highlights: Burj Khalifa 'At The Top' fast-track entrance ticket included
VIP Desert Safari with dune bashing, camel ride, belly dance & BBQ dinner
Dubai Marina Luxury Dhow Dinner Cruise with live Tanoura dance
Museum of the Future entry and Palm Monorail to Atlantis

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Dhow Cruise Dinner
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport (DXB). Private transfer to hotel. In the evening, board a luxury illuminated Dhow cruise along sparkling Dubai Marina with a 5-star international buffet.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa At The Top
itinerary.description: Morning city orientation: Dubai Frame photo stop, Jumeirah Mosque, Burj Al Arab view. In the afternoon, ascend the 124th floor of Burj Khalifa, followed by Dubai Mall Fountain show.

itinerary.title: Museum of the Future & Red Dunes Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Morning visit to the iconic Museum of the Future. At 3 PM, jump into a 4x4 Cruiser for high-adrenaline desert dune bashing, sandboarding, falcon photography, and a starlight BBQ feast.

itinerary.title: Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis Aquaventure & Miracle Garden
itinerary.description: Ride the scenic Palm Monorail to Atlantis. Splash into Aquaventure Waterpark & Lost Chambers Aquarium, and stroll through 150 million blooming blossoms at Dubai Miracle Garden.

itinerary.title: Gold Souk Shopping & DXB Departure
itinerary.description: Shop for traditional spices and gold jewelry in Deira Old Souk. Take an Abra boat ride across Dubai Creek before transfer to airport for departure.

inclusions: 4 Nights in luxury 4-Star hotel with daily international breakfast
Burj Khalifa 124th + 125th Floor Observatory entrance pass
Full VIP Desert Safari with Dune Bashing, Camel Safari, Shisha & BBQ Buffet
Dubai Marina Dhow Dinner Cruise with entertainment
Airport pick up and drop off in private executive vehicle
UAE Tourist Visa assistance and all internal tourist dirham taxes
exclusions: International flights (can be bundled with real-time estimator)
Optional helicopter tour or skydiving over Palm Jumeirah

title: Bali Bliss: Ubud Rice Terraces, Nusa Penida & Beachclubs
overview: Experience the magic of Bali. Swing over the lush Tegallalang rice terraces in Ubud, watch fiery sunsets at cliffside Tanah Lot, take a speedboat to the famous T-Rex cliff at Nusa Penida, and chill at sunset beach clubs.
highlights: Full Day Nusa Penida Island Speedboat tour: Kelingking T-Rex Beach & Angel's Billabong
Iconic Bali Jungle Swing over cascading Ubud rice paddies
Romantic sunset seafood candlelit dinner on Jimbaran Bay beach
Private pool villa upgrade available

itinerary.title: Welcome to Denpasar & Seminyak Sunset
itinerary.description: Traditional Balinese flower garland welcome at Ngurah Rai Airport. Transfer to your resort. Unwind and watch your first Indian Ocean sunset at Seminyak beach.

itinerary.title: Ubud Monkey Forest, Tegallalang & Bali Swing
itinerary.description: Wander through the Sacred Monkey Forest sanctuary. Ride the adrenaline Bali Swing soaring above palm canopies and Tegallalang rice terraces.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour by Speedboat
itinerary.description: Fast boat to Nusa Penida. Visit the jaw-dropping Kelingking Beach (T-Rex Cliff), Broken Beach natural arch, and snorkel in crystal Angel's Billabong.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Clifftop Temple & Kecak Fire Dance
itinerary.description: Visit dramatic Uluwatu Temple perched 70m above crashing surf. Watch the hypnotic Kecak & Fire Dance at sunset, followed by candlelit seafood dinner on Jimbaran sands.

itinerary.title: Tanah Lot Temple & Balinese Spa Wellness
itinerary.description: Morning excursion to sacred Tanah Lot sea temple. Rejuvenate with a complimentary 2-hour traditional Balinese herbal oil massage.

itinerary.title: Denpasar Departure
itinerary.description: Final morning coffee and tropical smoothie bowls. Transfer to airport for your flight home.

inclusions: 5 Nights in luxury 4-star resort / villa with daily tropical breakfast
Nusa Penida day trip with return speedboat, private island car & lunch
Ubud Swing entry ticket with photography safety harness
Complimentary Jimbaran beach candlelight seafood dinner
Complimentary 2-hour Balinese couple massage session
Private air-conditioned car with English-speaking driver guide
exclusions: Indonesia Visa on Arrival (approx $35 payable at immigration)

title: Swiss Alpine Grandeur: Jungfraujoch, Titlis & Zurich
overview: Live the Bollywood dream in the Swiss Alps. Stand atop Jungfraujoch - Top of Europe at 11,332 ft, spin on the Rotair cable car up Mount Titlis, cruise pristine Lake Lucerne, and explore Zurich's historic Old Town.
highlights: Full Swiss Travel Pass (unlimited trains, buses, and alpine boats)
Jungfraujoch mountain railway ticket with Ice Palace exploration
Mount Titlis Rotair Cable Car and Cliff Walk suspension bridge
Scenic cruise on Lake Lucerne & Lake Zurich

itinerary.title: Arrive in Zurich & Scenic Train to Interlaken
itinerary.description: Land at Zurich Airport. Board the world-famous Swiss Federal Railway passing through emerald valleys and glass lakes to reach Interlaken.

itinerary.title: Jungfraujoch: Top of Europe (11,332 ft)
itinerary.description: Take the Eiger Express tricable gondola and cogwheel railway to Europe's highest station. Walk inside the Ice Palace and step out onto the Aletsch Glacier plateau.

itinerary.title: Interlaken Lakes & Lauterbrunnen 72 Waterfalls
itinerary.description: Cruise turquoise Lake Brienz, visit the fairytale valley of Lauterbrunnen with Staubbach Falls, and take a stroll through car-free alpine village Mürren.

itinerary.title: Lucerne: Chapel Bridge & Lion Monument
itinerary.description: Scenic train to Lucerne. Walk across the 14th-century wooden Chapel Bridge, visit the poignant Lion Monument, and take an evening boat cruise.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis & Rotair Revolving Cable Car
itinerary.description: Ascend Mount Titlis on the world's first revolving cable car. Brave the Titlis Cliff Walk - Europe's highest suspension bridge, and explore the Glacier Cave.

itinerary.title: Zurich Old Town & Bahnofstrasse Shopping
itinerary.description: Train to Zurich. Stroll along the luxury Bahnhofstrasse, explore Niederdorf Old Town streets, and visit the Lindt Home of Chocolate museum.

itinerary.title: Zurich Departure
itinerary.description: Savor authentic Swiss fondue and Swiss chocolates before boarding your flight back home from Zurich Airport.

inclusions: 6 Nights in premium 4-Star Swiss hotels with buffet breakfast
All-inclusive Swiss Rail Consecutive Pass (2nd class)
Excursion tickets to Jungfraujoch Top of Europe
Excursion tickets to Mount Titlis with Rotair Cable Car & Ice Flyer
Lake Lucerne boat cruise pass
Schengen Visa document assistance

title: Rishikesh Adrenaline Blitz: Grade IV Rafting, Bungee & Riverside Camp
overview: The ultimate adrenaline weekend for thrill seekers. Tackle 26 km of raging Grade III and IV white-water rapids on the Holy Ganges, take the plunge on India's highest 83-meter bungee jump at Mohan Chatti, and sleep under stars in a luxury riverside camp.
highlights: 26 km Marine Drive to NIM Beach white-water rafting with cliff jumping & body surfing
India's Highest 83m Fixed Platform Bungee Jump by Jumpin Heights included
Luxury Swiss cottage tents with attached washrooms, swimming pool, and bonfire
Evening Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan or Triveni Ghat

itinerary.title: Arrival at Shivpuri Camps & Ganga Aarti
itinerary.description: Check in to luxury riverside camp in Shivpuri. Welcome drink and camp lunch. Afternoon volleyball and pool relax. Evening transfer to Triveni Ghat for the soulful Ganga Aarti with oil lamps, followed by camp bonfire and BBQ.

itinerary.title: The Big Leap: 83m Bungee Jump & Giant Swing
itinerary.description: Drive to Jumpin Heights at Mohan Chatti. Undergo safety briefing by New Zealand jump masters. Step onto the cantilever platform 83 meters above the rocky river bed and take the leap! Receive your Dare to Jump certificate.

itinerary.title: 26 km White-Water Rafting & Departure
itinerary.description: Gear up with lifejackets, helmets, and paddles. Battle fierce rapids: 'Three Blind Mice', 'Crossfire', 'The Wall', and 'Roller Coaster'. Experience 25-foot cliff jumping. Conclude at Rishikesh for departure.

inclusions: 2 Nights stay in Luxury Swiss Tents with AC, attached bathroom, and swimming pool
All meals: 2 Breakfasts, 1 Lunch, 2 Evening Snacks, 2 Dinners (Veg & Non-Veg)
26 km White-Water Rafting with safety kayakers and certified river guides
India's Highest 83m Bungee Jump ticket with certificate & jump video
Evening camp bonfire with live acoustic music sessions
exclusions: Optional Asia's longest 1 km Flying Fox or 83m Giant Swing upgrade
Personal transport to Rishikesh (can be booked via Flight/Train/Bus estimator)

title: Bir Billing Paragliding & Kangra Mountain Expedition
overview: Soar high over the Dhauladhar ranges at the world's 2nd highest paragliding takeoff site. Take off from Billing at 8,000 ft, glide through thermals for 30 exhilarating minutes, and land in the serene Tibetan colony of Bir.
highlights: 30-Minute Tandem Paragliding flight with high-definition GoPro recording
Sunset hike to Billing takeoff ridge with overnight dome tent camping
Explore Chokling Monastery and Sherab Ling Tibetan settlement
Mountain biking through Kangra tea gardens

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bir & Tibetan Culture Walk
itinerary.description: Arrive in Bir. Stroll through the Tibetan Colony, visit Chokling Monastery, and taste authentic Tibetan momos and thukpa in local artist cafes.

itinerary.title: Billing Ridge Trek & The Big Flight
itinerary.description: Drive up to Billing takeoff site at 8,000 ft. Meet your tandem pilot. Catch the thermal winds and fly above deodar forests and tea plantations. Land at Bir landing ground.

itinerary.title: Kangra Tea Estate Ride & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning mountain cycle ride through organic tea gardens. Relax with herbal Kangra green tea before boarding your return bus/cab.

inclusions: 2 Nights stay (1 Night Hotel + 1 Night Billing Ridge Camp)
20-30 min Tandem Paragliding flight with certified pilot
GoPro Action Camera video footage on SD card
Buffet breakfast and dinners
Bonfire and stargazing at Billing ridge
exclusions: Transport to Bir (bus/train from Delhi/Chandigarh available via estimator)

title: Kedarkantha Summit Winter Snow Trek (12,500 ft)
overview: One of India's most sought-after winter treks in Govind Pashu Vihar National Park. Climb from the quaint wooden village of Sankri through frozen Juda Ka Talab lake to the pyramid peak of Kedarkantha at 12,500 ft.
highlights: Summit climb to 12,500 ft with 360-degree view of Swargarohini, Bandarpoonch, and Black Peak
Camp on fresh snow beside frozen Juda Ka Talab alpine lake
High quality 4-season alpine tents, sub-zero sleeping bags, microspikes & gaiters
Certified Mountaineering Instructors (NIM/HMI) and emergency oxygen support

itinerary.title: Dehradun to Sankri Basecamp (6,400 ft)
itinerary.description: Drive 200 km along Yamuna and Tons rivers through Mussoorie and Purola to arrive at quaint hamlet Sankri.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Juda Ka Talab (9,100 ft)
itinerary.description: Trek 4 km through oak and pine forests blanketed in snow. Reach the magical frozen lake Juda Ka Talab for sunset camp.

itinerary.title: Juda Ka Talab to Kedarkantha Basecamp (11,250 ft)
itinerary.description: Gradual ascent through open snowy meadows. Incredible views of Bandarpoonch range. Early dinner for 3 AM summit push.

itinerary.title: Summit Push (12,500 ft) & Descent to Sankri
itinerary.description: Start early under headlamps. Reach the summit ridge for breathtaking sunrise touching Himalayan peaks. Descend back to Sankri.

itinerary.title: Sankri to Dehradun Departure
itinerary.description: Drive back to Dehradun Railway Station / Jolly Grant Airport with summit certificate and trek achievements.

inclusions: All accommodation (Homestay in Sankri + Alpine Tents during trek)
Nutritious high-altitude vegetarian meals + evening hot tea/soup
Trek equipment: 4-season tents, sleeping bags (-10°C), microspikes, gaiters
Forest permit, entry fees, and waste management charges
Qualified trek leaders, local guides, and cook team
exclusions: Transport from Dehradun to Sankri and back (available as add-on)
Personal trekking gear (trek shoes, thermal layers)

title: Meghalaya Wonderland: Cherrapunji, Living Root Bridges & Dawki Glass River
overview: Journey into the Abode of Clouds. Trek across the ancient bio-engineered Double Decker Living Root Bridge in Nongriat, witness India's tallest plunge waterfall Nohkalikai in Cherrapunji, boat on the crystal-clear glass waters of Dawki Umngot river, and explore Asia's cleanest village Mawlynnong.
highlights: Trek to the iconic Double Decker Living Root Bridge & Rainbow Falls in Nongriat
Boating on the emerald glass-clear waters of Dawki Umngot River along Bangladesh border
Majestic Cherrapunji: Nohkalikai Falls (1,115 ft) & Seven Sisters Falls
Walk the bamboo skywalk in Mawlynnong, recognized as Asia's cleanest village

itinerary.title: Arrival in Guwahati to Shillong (Scotland of the East)
itinerary.description: Pick up from Guwahati Airport/Station. Scenic drive through Umiam Lake (Barapani) with water sports. Check in to Shillong hotel, explore Police Bazar evening local handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Shillong to Cherrapunji (Sohra): Waterfalls & Caves
itinerary.description: Drive past misty ravines to Cherrapunji. Visit Nohkalikai Falls, Mawsmai limestone fossil caves, Seven Sisters Falls, and Eco Park overlooking Bangladesh plains.

itinerary.title: Trek to Double Decker Living Root Bridge (Nongriat)
itinerary.description: Guided trek descending 3,500 stone steps through tropical rainforest to Nongriat village. Marvel at the 250-year-old Double Decker living root bridge and take a dip in natural turquoise spring pools.

itinerary.title: Dawki Umngot River & Indo-Bangla Border
itinerary.description: Drive to Dawki border town. Experience the world-famous boat ride on crystal Umngot river where boats appear to float in mid-air. Visit Tamabil border gate.

itinerary.title: Mawlynnong Clean Village & Living Root Bridge Mawlynnong
itinerary.description: Explore Mawlynnong village's flower-lined stone pathways, organic orchards, and bamboo observation tower. Cross the single-tier Riwai living root bridge.

itinerary.title: Shillong Peak, Elephant Falls & Guwahati Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Elephant Falls and Shillong Peak for panoramic valley views. Transfer to Guwahati Airport with authentic Khasi hill memories.

inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in premium eco-resorts & scenic mountain hotels
Daily hearty buffet breakfast and traditional/multi-cuisine dinners
All transfers and sightseeing in dedicated private AC Innova/Scorpio vehicle
Nongriat Living Root Bridge trekking guide and entry forest permits
Boating ride on Dawki Umngot River included

title: Heritage to Coastline: Delhi Monuments & Goa Sun-Kissed Beaches
overview: From the imperial Mughal capitals of Delhi to the sun-drenched golden sands of Goa. Experience centuries of history at Qutub Minar, followed by water sports on Baga Beach, Dudhsagar Falls jeep safari, and Portuguese cathedrals.
highlights: Delhi Heritage: India Gate, Qutub Minar & Red Fort architectural glory
Goa Golden Sands: Baga, Calangute & Anjuna beach shacks with sunset music
Excursion to Dudhsagar Waterfalls (310m) jeep safari in Mollem National Park
17th-century Fort Aguada & UNESCO Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi & Monument Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in Delhi. Visit Qutub Minar, Humayun Tomb, and drive past Parliament House & India Gate.

itinerary.title: Old Delhi Heritage & Flight to Goa
itinerary.description: Explore Chandni Chowk and Jama Masjid. Afternoon flight to Dabolim/Mopa Goa. Check in to beachfront resort.

itinerary.title: North Goa Beaches & Fort Aguada
itinerary.description: Visit 17th-century Portuguese Fort Aguada lighthouse. Afternoon water sports at Baga & Calangute beaches.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Jungle Safari
itinerary.description: Thrilling open-jeep safari through Bhagwan Mahavir Wildlife Sanctuary to the majestic 4-tiered Dudhsagar milky waterfall.

itinerary.title: Old Goa Heritage & Mandovi Sunset Cruise
itinerary.description: Visit Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral. Evening luxury cruise along Mandovi River with Goan folk dances.

itinerary.title: South Goa Tranquility & Sunset Shacks
itinerary.description: Relax at pristine Colva and Palolem beaches, shop in Panjim Latin Quarter (Fontainhas).

itinerary.title: Goa Departure
itinerary.description: Morning breakfast with Arabian sea breeze. Transfer to Goa Airport for flight back home.

Dudhsagar waterfall jeep permit and Mandovi sunset river cruise ticket

title: Maximum City Charm: Mumbai Gateway, Marine Drive & Elephanta Island
overview: Feel the electric pulse of the City of Dreams. Ferry to UNESCO Elephanta Caves, drive across the engineering feat Bandra-Worli Sea Link, stroll the Queen’s Necklace at night, and savor iconic street chaat at Juhu Beach.
highlights: Iconic basalt Gateway of India and historic Colaba Causeway shopping
Scenic ferry ride across Mumbai harbor to rock-cut Elephanta Caves
Evening Marine Drive Queen’s Necklace walk & Bandra-Worli Sea Link cruise
Celebrity mansions at Bandra Bandstand and street food at Juhu Beach

itinerary.description: Arrive in Mumbai. Check in to hotel. Visit Gateway of India, Taj Mahal Palace Hotel, and Victoria Terminus (CSMT).

itinerary.title: Elephanta Caves & Marine Drive Sunset
itinerary.description: Board harbor ferry to Elephanta Island caves. Evening stroll along the 3.6 km Marine Drive glowing under night streetlights.

itinerary.title: Bandra-Worli Sea Link, Bandstand & Juhu
itinerary.description: Drive over the high-speed 8-lane Sea Link. Visit Mount Mary Church, Bandra street art, and sunset street food at Juhu Beach.

itinerary.title: Siddhi Vinayak & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Siddhivinayak Temple and Colaba souvenir shopping before transfer to airport/station.

Ferry tickets and toy train pass to Elephanta Caves
All sightseeing transfers in private AC sedan with toll/Sea Link charges
Professional certified local city guide

title: Royal Rajputana: Jaipur Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal & Nahargarh Sunset
overview: Live like royalty in Rajasthan’s Pink City. Gaze at the honeycomb facade of Hawa Mahal, explore the glittering mirror palace (Sheesh Mahal) inside hilltop Amber Fort, and enjoy golden hour sunsets from Nahargarh Fort.
highlights: Hilltop Amber Fort with Sheesh Mahal and optional elephant/jeep ride
Pink sandstone 953-window facade of Hawa Mahal and floating Jal Mahal
Royal armory and Chandra Mahal museum inside City Palace
Sunset tea and panoramic pink cityscape views atop Nahargarh Fort

itinerary.title: Arrival in Pink City & Chokhi Dhani
itinerary.description: Arrive in Jaipur. Check in to heritage hotel. Evening excursion to Chokhi Dhani ethnic village for folk dances and traditional Rajasthani thali.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort & Jal Mahal
itinerary.description: Ascend to Amber Fort. Marvel at the Sheesh Mahal. Photo stop at water palace Jal Mahal and visit ancient royal observatory Jantar Mantar.

itinerary.title: Hawa Mahal, City Palace & Nahargarh Sunset
itinerary.description: Photograph Hawa Mahal at sunrise. Tour Maharaja’s City Palace. Evening drive up the Aravalli hills for sunset over Jaipur from Nahargarh Fort.

itinerary.title: Bapu Bazar Shopping & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning handicraft shopping for blue pottery, bandhani dupattas and mojaris in Bapu Bazar before departure transfer.

Chokhi Dhani cultural village entry and traditional dinner feast

title: Tropical Andaman Paradise: Havelock Radhanagar, Neil Island & Coral Reefs
overview: Step onto Asia’s finest powder-white sands. Watch fiery tropical sunsets on Havelock Island’s Radhanagar Beach, snorkel with kaleidoscope clownfish at Elephant Beach, and marvel at the natural rock bridge on Neil Island.
highlights: Radhanagar Beach (Havelock), ranked among Asia’s best beaches
Elephant Beach snorkeling, jet-skiing and live coral reef exploration
Fast high-speed Catamaran luxury ferry transfers (Makruzz / Nautika)
Cellular Jail historic Light & Sound show and Ross Island British ruins

itinerary.title: Port Blair Arrival & Cellular Jail
itinerary.description: Arrive at Veer Savarkar Airport Port Blair. Visit national memorial Cellular Jail and attend evening patriotic Light & Sound Show.

itinerary.title: Catamaran to Havelock & Radhanagar Sunset
itinerary.description: Board premium Makruzz catamaran across Andaman Sea to Havelock Island. Afternoon relaxation at world-famous Radhanagar Beach.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkeling & Water Sports
itinerary.description: Speedboat to Elephant Beach for complimentary coral reef snorkeling. Optional sea walking and scuba diving.

itinerary.title: Neil Island Natural Bridge & Beaches
itinerary.description: Cruise to Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep). Visit natural rock bridge formation, Laxmanpur sunset beach and Bharatpur water sports beach.

itinerary.title: Ross Island Ruins & Return to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Ferry back to Port Blair. Short boat excursion to Ross Island (Netaji Subhash Bose Dweep) to see colonial ruins and roaming deer.

itinerary.title: Port Blair Departure
